planets.name: WASP-74 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-74 with a 2.14-day year, found in 2015.

text.card: WASP-74 b was found in 2015 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-74. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
